name: causalgraphicalmodels
what: Small causal-inference library; 'backdoor' is a technical term throughout.

bare.edit: the request alone: no description, nothing added to the README

use.context: Some context: I'm on the experimentation team. We use our fork of this library to plan our causal analyses: it finds the backdoor paths between a treatment and an outcome and lists the valid backdoor adjustment sets. The analysts use those sets to estimate treatment effects, and the results go into the product review.
